objective: Implement CW-09 durable delegation, TaskSpec revision, run/cancel history, session settings, and CW-08 message/delivery metadata boundary.
required_behavior: Persist stable Task identity separately from immutable sequential TaskSpec revisions; revision changes never reset Task ID and affect only later runs.

Require both persisted delegation scope approval and persisted explicit proceed instruction before creating a new automatic run. A metadata write failure must block the new run without mutating the prior durable state.

Record append-only run lifecycle and cancellation/revocation history. Immediate cancellation or authority revocation applies to the current run; a cancelled/revoked revision cannot be replayed as authorization.

Persist session-wide settings revisions and link each run/decision to the settings revision and retry count actually used. A settings change must not end the current run or reset its used retry count and applies to later decisions.

Provide a durable boundary for stable message_id, Task/revision/run links, logical message content, and separate delivery attempt/status history for CW-08. API return and confirmed OMP processing remain distinct.
Provide append-only linked shell lifecycle and takeover request/confirmation records without overwriting the run.

Use the standard library and a real durable local store with transactional constraints, foreign keys, restart/reopen tests, and explicit close/error behavior. Keep scope to CW-09; do not wire CW-08 or production policy.
constraints: Preserve existing user and G1-G4 changes; do not modify contracts/runtime/UI/shell/bridge/docs/PLAN/tickets/workflow/graphify.
Do not add dependencies without demonstrated need; prefer Python sqlite3 and explicit transactions.
Do not implement downstream mailbox, policy scheduling, UI, or final recovery.
checks: Run all tests/tasks including reopen/durability, approval/proceed ordering, revisions/current-run changes, cancellation/revocation, settings/retry linkage, message/delivery history, shell/takeover links, and injected write failures.
Run relevant G4 metadata/contract regressions and git diff --check.
